name: ui-mermaid-decomposer
description: Create, decompose, and grade advanced Mermaid diagrams with the two-axis technique — INTENT (relationship → type → skeleton → elements → labels) and RENDER (keyword → syntax → strict-safety → legibility) — backed by a gated M1–M6 rubric and a verbatim syntax catalog for the 11 advanced types (journey, gantt, erDiagram, sankey-beta, kanban, architecture-beta, treeView-beta, venn-beta, ishikawa-beta, wardley-beta, eventmodeling).
